tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Games of the catalogue with their slugs, card languages and price coverage per source. 0 credit.

tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Search the cards of a game by name or number, edition, language or rarity. 1 credit per page.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Full sheet of one card: edition, number, rarity, images, marketplace ids (Growth and up). 1 credit.

tools.name: get_card_prices
tools.description: Current prices of one card from Cardmarket, the US market and eBay sales, each in its native currency. 1 credit, +1 per include.

tools.name: get_cards_batch
tools.description: Current prices of up to 100 cards and sealed products (`sealed:{id}`) in one call. 1 credit per call, +1 per card and include.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Daily price history of one source for a card or a sealed product, bounded by the plan's history. 3 credits.

tools.name: list_editions
tools.description: Editions (sets) of a game, newest first, with their ids; `q` finds one by its name or set code. 1 credit per page.

tools.name: search_sealed
tools.description: Search the sealed products of a game (boosters, displays, ETB…) by name, edition, type or language. 1 credit per page.

tools.name: get_sealed_prices
tools.description: Current prices of one sealed product, each source in its native currency. 1 credit.

tools.name: identify_card
tools.description: Identify a card from free text (name, number, edition, language in any order, typos tolerated): up to 5 candidates, best first, with the signals that matched. 1 credit.

tools.name: price_summary
tools.description: The price the ValoTCG app shows for a card or a sealed product, in EUR, with its source, reliability and 7, 30 and 90-day changes. 1 credit, +1 per include.

tools.name: top_movers
tools.description: Largest price rises or falls of a game or an edition over 7, 30 or 90 days (cards of 10 EUR and more). 3 credits.

tools.name: top_priced
tools.description: Most valuable cards or sealed products of a game, by the price the ValoTCG app shows (EUR): every edition and language, or one edition, one language, one sealed product type. 3 credits.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Price summaries of up to 10 cards and sealed products (`sealed:{id}`) side by side. 1 credit, +1 per card and include.

tools.name: edition_overview
tools.description: Chase cards, sealed products with prices and price coverage of one edition. 3 credits.

tools.name: scan_card
tools.description: Recognise the card in a photo (Valo.Vision): up to 5 Valo.Data cards, best first; chain with price_summary for its price. 1 scan per analysed photo; a refused photo or an error costs nothing. Photos are processed in memory and never stored.
